speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To understand what is causing this, can you describe exactly how the feeding problems have started and if there is any vomiting or change in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception

The fussy behavior and pain upon palpation are highly suggestive of this condition. Can you confirm if there have been any episodes of "currant jelly" stools (blood and mucus mixed with stool) or if the abdomen has ever looked like a sausage? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray
